svg.text: A4 landscape | 2 / 4 | Named nets connect across sheets | NC = intentionally unused pin

text.tspan: U_MCU / RP2040 generates STEP/DIR and reads power status.
Internal regulator: 1.1 V core. Flash/clock/bypass: next sheet.

svg.text: U_ESD / USBLC6 protects D+/D-. R_CC1/2 identify a USB sink.

text.tspan: Q_DATA / MMBT3904 senses host 5 V without a direct GPIO feed.
R_RUN holds reset high; SWD / RUN pads allow debug.
USB ROM boot: BOOT pads on next sheet.
